changes.title: New API endpoint guarded by a permission: GET /api/customers/{customerId}/credit-limit-status
changes.risk_reason: New capability; confirm the guard matches the permission the PRD/story names.

plain.headline: New protected action: Viewing customers › credit limit status
plain.what: There is a new action in the app (viewing customers › credit limit status). Only people with one of 18 permissions (for example “Customers — Create & Edit” or “Customers — View”) can use it.
plain.why: A new feature: make sure the right people can use it and nobody else can.
check: Log in as someone whose role has one of the permissions listed and try it: it should work.
Log in as someone whose role has none of them and try it: it should be blocked, and the button or page should not be shown.

qa_scenarios: API authorisation: call GET /api/customers/{customerId}/credit-limit-status as a role WITH and a role WITHOUT "Customers — Create & Edit" — expect 2xx and 403.
Front end: the matching screen action is shown only to roles the API allows (front end blocks + back end allows = pass; the reverse is a defect).
Cross-role: try the same call as each system role whose defaults include or exclude the permission.
